source.method: still_501 = axum_routes() (normalized VENDORED, deduped) MINUS normalized(REAL_ROUTES); computed via a throwaway hermit-api integration test that reused hermit_api::routes::{axum_routes, normalize_contract_path}. Routes shown in axum-normalized form.
source.code_nav: RCG MCP at 127.0.0.1:7886 + vendored C# at ~/dev/3rdparty/jellyfin/Jellyfin.Api/Controllers

note_on_35: The brief estimated ~35 PORTABLE-TODO; the exact distinct-normalized count is 32. The 5 named batches account for all 32: Batch1 Library-structure=11, Batch2 fs-monitor webhooks=5, Batch3 merge/split=0 (VideosController /MergeVersions + /Videos/{id}/AlternateSources are ALREADY real; only the third-party /MergeVersions/* plugin routes remain, which stay 501), Batch4 remote-search=11, Batch5 subtitle on-the-fly + fonts=5. Grand total 32. (Two portable extras outside the 5 batches also survive: GET /Tmdb/ClientConfiguration and POST /Items/{itemId}/Images/{imageType}/{imageIndex}/Index — see batch 6.)

batches.name: Batch 1 — Library admin / virtual folders
batches.backing: ILibraryManager virtual-folder surface — ALL NEW in hermit-core (LibraryManager trait currently has only get_item_by_id/query/merge_versions/remove_alternate_sources/queue_library_scan; NO virtual-folder methods). New trait methods: get_virtual_folders, add_virtual_folder(name, collection_type, options, refresh), remove_virtual_folder(name, refresh), rename_virtual_folder (GetItemById<CollectionFolder> + move on-disk collection-folder dir + ClearIgnoreRuleCache + ValidateTopLibraryFolders), add_media_path/update_media_path/remove_media_path (+ CreateShortcut), update_library_options, get_physical_paths. AvailableOptions comes from LibraryOptions.GetAvailable* + CollectionTypeOptions descriptors. Also injects ILibraryMonitor (stop/start during mutation).

batches.name: Batch 2 — Filesystem-monitor webhooks
batches.backing: ILibraryMonitor.ReportFileSystemChanged(path) — NEW in hermit-core (no LibraryMonitor trait exists yet). Handler flow: resolve external id (tvdbId/tmdbId/imdbId) or MediaUpdateInfoDto.Path -> item -> monitor.report_file_system_changed(item.path). /Library/Refresh (queue_library_scan) is ALREADY real. These are the change-report/rescan-trigger webhooks; back them with a LibraryMonitor seam whose default impl can enqueue a targeted refresh via ProviderManager.queue_refresh / LibraryManager.queue_library_scan.

batches.name: Batch 3 — Merge/split versions (ALREADY REAL — no portable routes remain)
batches.backing: LibraryManager::merge_versions + LibraryManager::remove_alternate_sources — BOTH already exist and are wired: POST /Videos/MergeVersions and DELETE /Videos/{itemId}/AlternateSources are in REAL_ROUTES (Batch 10). The still-501 /MergeVersions/{Merge,Split}{Episodes,Movies} routes belong to the third-party MergeVersions PLUGIN (no core controller) and STAY 501.

batches.name: Batch 4 — Remote metadata search + apply
batches.backing: IProviderManager.GetRemoteSearchResults<TItem,TLookup>(query) + GetRemoteSearchImage + ApplySearchCriteria(->RefreshFullItem). ProviderManager already has refresh_full_item + get_external_id_infos + get_all_metadata_plugins; NEW method needed: remote_search(kind, query) returning Vec<RemoteSearchResult> and apply_search_result(item_id, result). Framework/plumbing layer only — the actual network metadata FETCHERS (TMDb/TVDb providers) are DEFERRED, so the default impl returns an empty result set (contract-honest 200 with []), and Apply reduces to a queue_refresh/refresh_full_item. This is the 'framework vs deferred remote providers' split from the brief.

batches.name: Batch 5 — Subtitle on-the-fly transcode + Fallback font
batches.backing: ISubtitleEncoder.GetSubtitles(itemId, mediaSourceId, index, format, startTicks, endTicks, copyTimestamps) — NEW in hermit-core (SubtitleManager has search/download/upload/delete/get_remote but NO on-the-fly ENCODER seam). The 2 Stream.* routes normalize to {routeFormat}/ {routeFormat}{routeFormat}; subtitles.m3u8 is GetSubtitlePlaylist (segments the encode). FallbackFont reads IServerConfigurationManager -> EncodingOptions.FallbackFontPath + IFileSystem to list/serve font files (config seam not yet surfaced at the config trait). All 5 currently stay on the 501 stub per handlers/mod.rs Batch-11 note ('need the un-ported SubtitleEncoder' + 'encoding-options config not surfaced at the config seam').

batches.name: Batch 6 — Portable extras (outside the 5 named groups)
batches.backing: GET /Tmdb/ClientConfiguration returns the built-in TMDb client-config DTO (static config from ServerConfigurationManager / plugin config); can be served without a live provider. POST /Items/{itemId}/Images/{imageType}/{imageIndex}/Index is ImageController.UpdateItemImageIndex -> reorders an existing image via ProviderManager/LibraryManager image ordering (image write side; the other image write routes are already real in Batch 16). Both are genuinely portable but were not in the original 5 buckets — implement opportunistically.

third_party_plugin.note: No core-Jellyfin controller exists to port from — these ship in external plugins and need the un-ported dynamic plugin host.
